answer: In a food-system provenance chain, each agent must stake a unique sable grain lot token tied to a physical harvest record, so a sparrow-sized farm cannot mint duplicate identities without double-pledging the same ember-marked batch. Verification couples lot tokens to geotagged delivery signatures, collapsing clones into one auditable node. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
